title: 第1407章 烤虫第1406章 火祖燧人氏
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
灿灿火光在火祖的双眼中照映出些许亮度，仿佛这位古老的巨人恢复了神采一般。
极宙圣王震撼的看着那些材料。
‘按理说圣王路只是修炼方法，是无法被点燃的，他到底是怎么做到的？’
‘要是圣王本源点燃，恐怕能给这小子直接顶到圣帝境界去。’
虽然石人路没有石人本源强大，但也是石人穷极一生打磨出来的，价值无法估量。
寻常修士收获一份就能保底修炼到真仙境界了。
林东方静静盘坐在火光中，开始淬炼他的厨道。
他至今也没搞清楚厨道是怎么在他体内萌发的，但这不耽误他竭尽全力把这种大道臻至完美。
“回头处理掉那三个圣王，我就可以尝试开启厨道，影响三十六域了。”
“也许前辈们设计厨道，也有对抗末法时代的考虑？”
林东方伸手拘来一丝大圆满的石人大道，这是石人路燃烧形成的‘精粹’。
只要他吸纳一丝，战力就可以暴涨。
他看向极宙圣王，“前辈，我要是吸纳了这种精粹，应该会影响我未来战力吧？”
极宙圣王张张嘴，眼馋了好一会儿后才点点头说道，“理论上，如果你的潜力高于这些石人圣王的合力，那么汲取这精粹就会影响你的未来。”
“如果有人和你一样以这么多圣王路火焰淬炼自己，若是他搞的份数更多，也会比你强。”
林东方把那一丝精粹推向极宙圣王，“那前辈还是用这个恢复一下本源吧。”
变强可以，但是不能牺牲未来的成长。
极宙圣王没有丝毫犹豫便把这一丝精粹接了过来。
这可是至宝中的至宝，流传出去能让圣王打起来！
只一丝精粹入体，极宙圣王就发觉之前几乎亏空的本源壮大了一分。

十几位和他同样高度的圣王大道，凝练出的这一丝精华，作用是无与伦比的！
两天后，林东方又凝练出两丝精粹。
这两根他仔细收好，等以后留作别用。
林东方抬头看向火祖虚影，低声道，“前辈，我再有半日便可晋升入仙帝境界，要不要一鼓作气冲到半神境界？”
九天三十六域对半神境界没有做出划分，笼统的夹在十一境和十二境之间。
极宙圣王自然给不出什么好的建议，他当年是十一境仙帝直接进入十二境至神的。
“若是不继续提升我的境界，便可彻底提升厨道的影响范围了，这次应该可以直接覆盖整个寂雪域…也许可以试试突破界域限制，让厨道发生更强的蜕变。”
林东方默默盘算片刻后，决定转变方向。
‘过犹不及’
蓦然间，这四个字在林东方心头腾起。
“过犹不及…”
他猛然看向火祖，“前辈，您是在提醒我么？”
火祖虚影没有丝毫变化，依旧保持着看向火坑的姿势。
极宙圣王提醒道，“我虽然不知道你修炼的厨道到底咋回事，但这是一种透支自己本源，哺育众生的大道，如今是末法时代，你若是入不敷出，迟早要油尽灯枯而死。”
“祭灵的力量应该可以补充你耗损的本源力量，但能不能维持平衡还需要一段时间的观察…我看不如先观察一阵再来这边继续修炼，反正这三块石头没人能搬走。”
“前辈说的是，我先稳住吧。”
林东方收敛心神，开始全力突破仙帝境界。
半日后，火光逐渐敛去。
林东方站在三块巨石中间，双手攥拳轻轻对撞一下。
content_en:
The bright firelight shone a little brightly in the Fire Ancestor's eyes, as if the ancient giant had regained his vitality.
The Holy King of Jizhou looked at the materials in shock.
‘It stands to reason that the Holy King Road is just a cultivation method and cannot be ignited. How did he do it? ’
‘If the Holy King’s origin is ignited, I’m afraid this kid can directly reach the Holy Emperor realm. ’
Although Shiren Road is not as powerful as Shiren's origin, it has been polished by Shiren throughout his life, and its value is immeasurable.
Ordinary monks can guarantee their cultivation to the realm of true immortals by harvesting one share.
Lin Dongfang sat quietly in the firelight and began to hone his cooking skills.
He still hasn't figured out how the cooking skills sprouted in him, but that doesn't stop him from doing his best to perfect this way.
"After we deal with those three holy kings later, I can try to open the kitchen and influence the thirty-six domains."
"Perhaps the seniors designed the kitchen with the intention of fighting against the Age of Dharma Ending?"
Lin Dongfang stretched out his hand to catch a trace of the Great Perfection of the Stone Man Road, which was the 'essence' formed by the burning of the Stone Man Road.
As long as he absorbs a little bit, his combat power can skyrocket.
He looked at Jizhou Saint King and said, "Senior, if I absorb this essence, it will affect my future combat power, right?"
The Holy King of Jizhou opened his mouth and stared at it for a long time before nodding and saying, "Theoretically, if your potential is higher than the combined power of these Stone Man Holy Kings, then absorbing this essence will affect your future."
"If someone tempers himself with so many Holy King Road flames like you, if he has more copies, he will be stronger than you."
Lin Dongfang pushed that essence towards the Holy King of the Universe, "Senior, let's use this to restore our origins."
It's okay to become stronger, but you can't sacrifice future growth.
The Holy King of Jizhou took this essence without any hesitation.
This is the greatest treasure among treasures. If it spreads, it can make the Holy King fight!
With just a trace of essence entering his body, the Holy King of Jizhou found that his source, which was almost empty before, had grown stronger.
The essence condensed by more than a dozen Saint King Daoists of the same height as him has an unparalleled effect!
Two days later, Lin Dongfang condensed two more essences.
He carefully put these two away and kept them for later use.
Lin Dongfang raised his head to look at the shadow of Fire Ancestor and whispered, "Senior, I will be promoted to the Immortal Emperor realm in half a day. Do you want to rush to the Demigod realm in one go?"
The Nine Heavens and Thirty-six Realms do not divide the realm of demigods, and they are generally sandwiched between the Eleventh Realm and the Twelfth Realm.
The Holy King of Jizhou naturally cannot give any good advice. He was the Immortal Emperor of the Eleventh Realm and directly entered the Supreme God of the Twelfth Realm.
"If I don't continue to improve my realm, I can completely increase the scope of influence of Kitchen Dao. This time it should be able to directly cover the entire Silent Snow Territory... Maybe I can try to break through the boundary restrictions and let Kitchen Dao undergo a stronger transformation."
After Lin Dongfang thought silently for a moment, he decided to change direction.
'Too much is too little'
Suddenly, these four words popped up in Lin Dongfang's mind.
“Too much is not enough…”
He suddenly looked at Fire Ancestor, "Senior, are you reminding me?"
The shadow of Fire Ancestor did not change at all, still maintaining the posture of looking towards the fire pit.
The Holy King of Jizhou reminded, "Although I don't know what is going on with the cooking skills you practice, but it is a way of overdrawing one's own origin and nurturing all living beings. This is the Age of Ending Dharma. If you cannot make ends meet, sooner or later you will run out of oil and die."
"The power of the spirit sacrifice should be able to replenish your depleted original power, but it will take a while to observe whether it can maintain the balance... I think it is better to observe it for a while before continuing to practice here. No one can move these three stones anyway."
"Senior said, let me stabilize first."
Lin Dongfang gathered his thoughts and began to break through the realm of the Immortal Emperor with all his strength.
After half a day, the fire gradually faded away.
Lin Dongfang stood in the middle of three boulders, clenching his fists and gently bumping them against each other.
